why: I compared the verifier brief's checks with the two expect lines. Check 1 matches expect line 1: it diffs the CSV output against the --tsv output. Its PASS/FAIL condition doesn't require npm test, so must_not item 2 holds. Check 2 matches expect line 2 (grep README.md for --tsv). But the brief also has "Check 3. Existing behaviour: npm test passes" with "Run: npm test". That makes three checks for two expect lines. It is exactly the third npm test check that must_not item 1 forbids, so the output breaks the criterion. The builder brief running npm test isn't on the must_not list.
